title: Defra UNVTD DOCOM profile
description: Intra-Union commercial document (DOCOM) certificate, as issued by TRACES for movements of animals and products not requiring an INTRA certificate. Part III follow-up records (redispatch and control outcomes) are carried on followUp; TRACES returns them alongside the certificate, and their shapes are defined in defra-unvtd-profile-docom-followup-v1.schema.json.

documentTypeCode.description: UNTDID 1001 code 332 — commercial document. TRACES issues DOCOM under this code.

followUp.description: Part III follow-up records in the order TRACES returned them (TRACES DocomFollowUp). TRACES appends one record per follow-up action over the certificate's life, each carrying redispatch details, control outcomes, or both. Absent until the first follow-up is recorded.
